description: Reminders and lists, never alarms or timers. Set, change, snooze, finish, cancel or show reminders, and create, rename, copy, empty or show lists, add, remove, check off, edit, move or reorder the things on them, or take back the last change. Pass words, never ids: the list as the person named it, the items as they said them. Act directly: do not look a list or reminder up first, since the host finds it by name. When the person says that or those, leave the words out and the last list or items are used. If a request could mean more than one list or reminder, or names none and none was mentioned, reply with a short question and make no call.

expression.description: For a reminder: what to remember and when, in the person's words. For a list action: the item text or new name when no other field fits.

action.description: What to do. Always give it for a list action or a change to an existing reminder; omit it only to make a brand new reminder. The first six values act on reminders, the rest on lists. Moving a reminder to a new time is edit_reminder; pushing it later by a length of time is snooze_reminder. Showing what was asked to be remembered is list_reminders. Use undo for any request to take back, reverse or revert the last change, including taking an item back off.

list.description: The list the person named, in their words, such as groceries. Omit when they said that or my list and only one list fits.

to_list.description: The list that receives the items for move_items. The list field holds the list they come from.

items.description: Item words, one string per item, as the person said them. Required for add_items, remove_items, check_items, uncheck_items and move_items unless they said those.

name.description: A new list name for create_list, rename_list and copy_list, or the new item text for edit_item.

exclude.description: Items to leave out when copy_list copies a list.

order.description: For reorder: the item words that go first, in the order wanted. Omit it for a sort the person describes in general terms.

reminder.description: Which reminder, in the person's words, for edit_reminder, snooze_reminder, complete_reminder and cancel_reminder. Omit it when they said that.

minutes.description: For snooze_reminder: how many minutes to move the reminder later.

task.description: For edit_reminder: the new words of the reminder.

when.description: For edit_reminder: the new time, in the person's words.
